description: APPLICATION FOR THE ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION AND PART REAR ROOF EXTENSION (WITH LOSS OF ROOF TERRACE). DEMOLITION AND REPLACEMENT OF AN EXISTING SINGLE-STOREY GARAGE WITH A SINGLE-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site Location Plan; P04; PO2; PO5; P01; P03; Design and Access Statement; Flood Map for Planning; Covering email 10.11.2025; Tree Report Aboricultural Impact Assessment and Arboricultural Method Statement; Tree Report Appendix I Tree Survey Schedule; Tree Report Appendix II Tree Constraints Plan; Tree Report Appendix III Tree Retention and Protection Plan.

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the approved plan drawing number P03 unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Tree Protection: The details and measures for the protection of the existing trees as specified 
in the hereby approved document `Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Method Statement and 
Tree Protection Plan� reference '05/RAC/25' and dated �13 October 2025' shall be fully 
complied with. The methods for the protection of the existing trees shall fully accord with all of 
the measures specified in the report and shall be installed prior to the commencement of any 
site works and shall remain in place until the conclusion of all site works. 

Reason: To protect 
and safeguard the existing trees in accordance with the following Development Plan policies 
for Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021,policies 015.1, 015.2 and 015.4 of the Local 
Plan 2024.

Condition : 5 -  Site Supervision (Trees) - The details of the approved document 'Arboricultural Impact 
Assessment, Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan' shall include the retention of an 
arboricultural expert to monitor and report to the Local Planning Authority not less than 
monthly the status of all tree works and tree protection measures throughout the course of the 
demolition and site works. A final Certificate of Completion shall be submitted to and agreed 
in writing by the Local Planning Authority at the conclusion of all site works and prior to the 
first occupation of the development hereby approved. The works shall be carried out in 
accordance with the approved Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection 
Plan.

Reason: To protect and safeguard the existing trees in accordance with the following Development Plan policies or Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021,policies 015.1, 015.2 and 015.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

Condition : 6 - Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the new first floor window in the north facing side elevation shall be glazed with obscured glass and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 7 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Condition : 8 - Landscaping  (Implementation) - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details as shown on drawing number P05. The works shall be carried out in the first available planting season following the completion of the development or prior to the occupation of any part of the development, whichever is the sooner, and any trees which die within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased or are dying, shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of same approved specification, unless the Local Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation. All hard surfacing and means of enclosure shall be completed before the development is first occupied.

Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVE
Building Regulations 
Please note that this is a planning permission only and you may also require approval under the Building Regulations. If you are in any doubt about this you can get further information via https://www.merton.gov.uk/planning-and-buildings/building-control  or by emailing building.control@merton.gov.uk.

Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE - Bricks

The Council as local planning authority, recognizes the importance of achieving high standards of site practice and workmanship in the course of construction and acknowledges that this will have significant influence upon the quality of the finished brickwork.

The applicant is therefore encouraged to follow the advice set out in the Brick Development Association publication: Good site practice and workmanship (December 2015)  https://www.brick.org.uk/admin/resources/g-good-site-practice-workmanship.pdf when implementing the development hereby approved.

Condition : 11 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works

Condition : 12 - INFORMATIVE
The London Borough of Merton's Environmental Health Service set out that normally the hours for noisy works are:
8am - 6pm on Monday to Friday
8am - 1pm on Saturday
no noisy works on Sundays and Bank Holidays
Further details can be found here: https://www.merton.gov.uk/communities-and-neighbourhoods/noise-nuisance/report-nuisance/building-noise

Condition : 13 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.
